title: facts that feel ILLEGAL to know 🤯 | part 1
description: Five facts that should honestly be classified. Part 2 tomorrow.
hook: These facts feel illegal to know.
facts: Honey from Egyptian tombs is over three thousand years old. And still perfectly edible.
Sharks are older than trees. By about seventy million years.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the Great Pyramid being built.
Nintendo was founded in eighteen eighty nine. To sell playing cards.
outro: Follow for part two. It gets worse.
